blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lucio Tan-led Philippine National Bank (PNB) is considering a bond issuance early next year to support lending expansion, although the amount, currency and tenor have yet to be determined. PNB president and CEO Edwin Bautista said the bank had no immediate funding requirement for the rest of 2026 but could tap the debt market in early 2027. READ: PNB expects to sustain double-digit growth pace “We haven’t talked about it yet, but we just know we might need it,” Bautista said in an interview.
